t: Yazoo (band) - Wikipedia
s: January 4, 2026 - Yazoo (known as Yaz in North America) were an English synth-pop duo from Basildon, Essex, formed in late 1981 by Alison Moyet (vocals) and former Depeche Mode member Vince Clarke (keyboards). The pair released two albums, Upstairs at Eric's (1982) and You and Me Both (1983).

t: Yazoo (drink) - Wikipedia
s: July 20, 2025 - Yazoo is a bottled milk-based flavoured drink, produced by FrieslandCampina and sold in Belgium, France, the United Kingdom and Ireland. Over eighty million bottles of Yazoo are sold annually. Yazoo is available in four flavours; banana, chocolate, strawberry and vanilla.
